svg.aria-label: ArthaFlow Global: The operating system for global trade. Data ingestion across DGFT/DGCIS/CBIC — 12,402 ITC-HS lines × 7 financial years, reconciling to India's published $441.5bn book. Retrieve-then-choose HS classification that structurally cannot hallucinate a code. 134+ pinned assertions, validated by mutation testing.
